svg.title: Legendary Arena — Color Palette v1 (Light + Dark)
svg.desc: Color swatch derived from docs/brand/palette.md. Brand identity = 3 colors only (gold, red, blue), shown at the top with HEX/RGB for quick reference. Full variants for each brand color appear in their own sections below (§4.1, §4.2, §4.3). CTA (§4.2.1) and class colors (§4.4) are mode-stable.
svg.text: Light mode (left) · Dark mode (right) · Source: docs/brand/palette.md
BRAND IDENTITY = 3 COLORS — GOLD · RED · BLUE
THE THREE BRAND COLORS — at a glance (full variants below in §4.1, §4.2, §4.3)
§4.1 Gold (brand / achievement) — BRAND COLOR 1 of 3 · full variants
§4.2 Red (action / accents) — BRAND COLOR 2 of 3 · full variants
§4.2.1 CTA — primary action backgrounds (mode-stable: same in light + dark)
